description-zh: 对整数切片进行升序排序
description-en: Sort integer slice in ascending order
code:
import "sort"

func sortSlice(nums []int) []int {
    result := make([]int, len(nums))
    copy(result, nums)
    sort.Ints(result)
    return result
}
